title: Grimy Chest
summary: Sturdy storage chest with 50 object HP.

fields.Storage: Open to look for or store contents.
fields.Object defences: 50 HP and Sturdy. Single hits must deal at least 10 damage to hurt the chest. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning, resistant to Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, immune to Poison and Psychic.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
